concept.title: Introduction to the fixture
concept.shortdesc: This fixture publication exercises the elements the proof of concept must render with GOV.UK Design System styling.

conbody.p: Each page of this publication tests part of the plugin. The sidebar on the left shows the whole publication; the page you are reading now should be highlighted there.
Body text renders in the GOV.UK typography scale. Links, such as this one to the notes page, use the standard link style, including focus and hover states.

ul.li: Unordered lists use bulleted GOV.UK list styling.

conbody.note: Notes without a warning character, like this tip, render as inset text.
